Exsultáte, iusti, * et gloriámini, omnes recti corde.

content.latin: Psalmus 31 [1]
content.english: Psalm 31 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 31

content.latin: 31:1 Beáti quorum remíssæ sunt iniquitátes: * et quorum tecta sunt peccáta.
content.english: 31:1 Blessed are those whose iniquities are forgiven * and whose sins are covered.

segments.t: Beáti quorum remíssæ sunt iniquitátes: * et quorum tecta sunt peccáta.

content.latin: 31:2 Beátus vir, cui non imputávit Dóminus peccátum, * nec est in spíritu eius dolus.
content.english: 31:2 Blessed is the man to whom the Lord hath not imputed sin, * and in whose spirit there is no guile.

segments.t: Beátus vir, cui non imputávit Dóminus peccátum, * nec est in spíritu eius dolus.

content.latin: 31:3 Quóniam tácui, inveteravérunt ossa mea, * dum clamárem tota die.
content.english: 31:3 Because I was silent my bones grew old; * whilst I cried out all the day long.

segments.t: Quóniam tácui, inveteravérunt ossa mea, * dum clamárem tota die.

content.latin: 31:4 Quóniam die ac nocte graváta est super me manus tua: * convérsus sum in ærúmna mea, dum confígitur spina.
content.english: 31:4 For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: * I am turned in my anguish, whilst the thorn is fastened.

segments.t: Quóniam die ac nocte graváta est super me manus tua: * convérsus sum in ærúmna mea, dum confígitur spina.

content.latin: 31:5 Delíctum meum cógnitum tibi feci: * et iniustítiam meam non abscóndi.
content.english: 31:5 I have acknowledged my sin to thee, * and my injustice I have not concealed.

segments.t: Delíctum meum cógnitum tibi feci: * et iniustítiam meam non abscóndi.

content.latin: 31:5 Dixi: Confitébor advérsum me iniustítiam meam Dómino: * et tu remisísti impietátem peccáti mei.
content.english: 31:5 I said I will confess against myself my injustice to the Lord: * and thou hast forgiven the wickedness of my sin.

segments.t: Dixi: Confitébor advérsum me iniustítiam meam Dómino: * et tu remisísti impietátem peccáti mei.

content.latin: 31:6 Pro hac orábit ad te omnis sanctus, * in témpore opportúno.
content.english: 31:6 For this shall every one that is holy pray to thee * in a seasonable time.

segments.t: Pro hac orábit ad te omnis sanctus, * in témpore opportúno.

content.latin: 31:6 Verúmtamen in dilúvio aquárum multárum, * ad eum non approximábunt.
content.english: 31:6 And yet in a flood of many waters, * they shall not come nigh unto him.

segments.t: Verúmtamen in dilúvio aquárum multárum, * ad eum non approximábunt.

content.latin: 31:7 Tu es refúgium meum a tribulatióne, quæ circúmdedit me: * exsultátio mea, érue me a circumdántibus me.
content.english: 31:7 Thou art my refuge from the trouble which hath encompassed me: * my joy, deliver me from them that surround me.

segments.t: Tu es refúgium meum a tribulatióne, quæ circúmdedit me: * exsultátio mea, érue me a circumdántibus me.

content.latin: 31:8 Intelléctum tibi dabo, et ínstruam te in via hac, qua gradiéris: * firmábo super te óculos meos.
content.english: 31:8 I will give thee understanding, and I will instruct thee in this way, in which thou shalt go: * I will fix my eyes upon thee.

segments.t: Intelléctum tibi dabo, et ínstruam te in via hac, qua gradiéris: * firmábo super te óculos meos.

content.latin: 31:9 Nolíte fíeri sicut equus et mulus, * quibus non est intelléctus.
content.english: 31:9 Do not become like the horse and the mule, * who have no understanding.

segments.t: Nolíte fíeri sicut equus et mulus, * quibus non est intelléctus.

content.latin: 31:9 In camo et freno maxíllas eórum constrínge, * qui non appróximant ad te.
content.english: 31:9 With bit and bridle bind fast their jaws, * who come not near unto thee.

segments.t: In camo et freno maxíllas eórum constrínge, * qui non appróximant ad te.

content.latin: 31:10 Multa flagélla peccatóris, * sperántem autem in Dómino misericórdia circúmdabit.
content.english: 31:10 Many are the scourges of the sinner, * but mercy shall encompass him that hopeth in the Lord.

segments.t: Multa flagélla peccatóris, * sperántem autem in Dómino misericórdia circúmdabit.

content.latin: 31:11 Lætámini in Dómino et exsultáte, iusti, * et gloriámini, omnes recti corde.
content.english: 31:11 Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye just, * and glory, all ye right of heart.

segments.t: Lætámini in Dómino et exsultáte, iusti, * et gloriámini, omnes recti corde.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 32(1-11)

content.latin: 32:1 Exsultáte, iusti, in Dómino: * rectos decet collaudátio.
content.english: 32:1 Rejoice in the Lord, O ye just: * praise becometh the upright.

segments.t: Exsultáte, iusti, in Dómino: * rectos decet collaudátio.

content.latin: 32:2 Confitémini Dómino in cíthara: * in psaltério decem chordárum psállite illi.
content.english: 32:2 Give praise to the Lord on the harp; * sing to him with the psaltery, the instrument of ten strings.

segments.t: Confitémini Dómino in cíthara: * in psaltério decem chordárum psállite illi.

content.latin: 32:3 Cantáte ei cánticum novum: * bene psállite ei in vociferatióne.
content.english: 32:3 Sing to him a new canticle, * sing well unto him with a loud noise.

segments.t: Cantáte ei cánticum novum: * bene psállite ei in vociferatióne.

content.latin: 32:4 Quia rectum est verbum Dómini, * et ómnia ópera eius in fide.
content.english: 32:4 For the word of the Lord is right, * and all his works are done with faithfulness.

segments.t: Quia rectum est verbum Dómini, * et ómnia ópera eius in fide.

content.latin: 32:5 Díligit misericórdiam et iudícium: * misericórdia Dómini plena est terra.
content.english: 32:5 He loveth mercy and judgment; * the earth is full of the mercy of the Lord.

segments.t: Díligit misericórdiam et iudícium: * misericórdia Dómini plena est terra.

content.latin: 32:6 Verbo Dómini cæli firmáti sunt: * et spíritu oris eius omnis virtus eórum.
content.english: 32:6 By the word of the Lord the heavens were established; * and all the power of them by the spirit of his mouth:

segments.t: Verbo Dómini cæli firmáti sunt: * et spíritu oris eius omnis virtus eórum.

content.latin: 32:7 Cóngregans sicut in utre aquas maris: * ponens in thesáuris abýssos.
content.english: 32:7 Gathering together the waters of the sea, as in a vessel; * laying up the depths in storehouses.

segments.t: Cóngregans sicut in utre aquas maris: * ponens in thesáuris abýssos.

content.latin: 32:8 Tímeat Dóminum omnis terra: * ab eo autem commoveántur omnes inhabitántes orbem.
content.english: 32:8 Let all the earth fear the Lord, * and let all the inhabitants of the world be in awe of him.

segments.t: Tímeat Dóminum omnis terra: * ab eo autem commoveántur omnes inhabitántes orbem.

content.latin: 32:9 Quóniam ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.
content.english: 32:9 For he spoke and they were made: * he commanded and they were created.

segments.t: Quóniam ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.

content.latin: 32:10 Dóminus díssipat consília géntium: * réprobat autem cogitatiónes populórum, et réprobat consília príncipum.
content.english: 32:10 The Lord bringeth to nought the counsels of nations; * and he rejecteth the devices of people, and casteth away the counsels of princes.

segments.t: Dóminus díssipat consília géntium: * réprobat autem cogitatiónes populórum, et réprobat consília príncipum.

content.latin: 32:11 Consílium autem Dómini in ætérnum manet: * cogitatiónes cordis eius in generatióne et generatiónem.
content.english: 32:11 But the counsel of the Lord standeth for ever: * the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

segments.t: Consílium autem Dómini in ætérnum manet: * cogitatiónes cordis eius in generatióne et generatiónem.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 32(12-22)

content.latin: 32:12 Beáta gens, cuius est Dóminus, Deus eius: * pópulus, quem elégit in hereditátem sibi.
content.english: 32:12 Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord: * the people whom he hath chosen for his inheritance.

segments.t: Beáta gens, cuius est Dóminus, Deus eius: * pópulus, quem elégit in hereditátem sibi.

content.latin: 32:13 De cælo respéxit Dóminus: * vidit omnes fílios hóminum.
content.english: 32:13 The Lord hath looked from heaven: * he hath beheld all the sons of men.

segments.t: De cælo respéxit Dóminus: * vidit omnes fílios hóminum.

content.latin: 32:14 De præparáto habitáculo suo * respéxit super omnes, qui hábitant terram.
content.english: 32:14 From his habitation which he hath prepared, * he hath looked upon all that dwell on the earth.

segments.t: De præparáto habitáculo suo * respéxit super omnes, qui hábitant terram.

content.latin: 32:15 Qui finxit sigillátim corda eórum: * qui intéllegit ómnia ópera eórum.
content.english: 32:15 He who hath made the hearts of every one of them: * who understandeth all their works.

segments.t: Qui finxit sigillátim corda eórum: * qui intéllegit ómnia ópera eórum.

content.latin: 32:16 Non salvátur rex per multam virtútem: * et gigas non salvábitur in multitúdine virtútis suæ.
content.english: 32:16 The king is not saved by a great army: * nor shall the giant be saved by his own great strength.

segments.t: Non salvátur rex per multam virtútem: * et gigas non salvábitur in multitúdine virtútis suæ.

content.latin: 32:17 Fallax equus ad salútem: * in abundántia autem virtútis suæ non salvábitur.
content.english: 32:17 Vain is the horse for safety: * neither shall he be saved by the abundance of his strength.

segments.t: Fallax equus ad salútem: * in abundántia autem virtútis suæ non salvábitur.

content.latin: 32:18 Ecce, óculi Dómini super metuéntes eum: * et in eis, qui sperant super misericórdia eius:
content.english: 32:18 Behold the eyes of the Lord are on them that fear him: * and on them that hope in his mercy.

segments.t: Ecce, óculi Dómini super metuéntes eum: * et in eis, qui sperant super misericórdia eius:

content.latin: 32:19 Ut éruat a morte ánimas eórum: * et alat eos in fame.
content.english: 32:19 To deliver their souls from death; * and feed them in famine.

segments.t: Ut éruat a morte ánimas eórum: * et alat eos in fame.

content.latin: 32:20 Ánima nostra sústinet Dóminum: * quóniam adiútor et protéctor noster est.
content.english: 32:20 Our soul waiteth for the Lord: * for he is our helper and protector.

segments.t: Ánima nostra sústinet Dóminum: * quóniam adiútor et protéctor noster est.

content.latin: 32:21 Quia in eo lætábitur cor nostrum: * et in nómine sancto eius sperávimus.
content.english: 32:21 For in him our heart shall rejoice: * and in his holy name we have trusted.

segments.t: Quia in eo lætábitur cor nostrum: * et in nómine sancto eius sperávimus.

content.latin: 32:22 Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos: * quemádmodum sperávimus in te.
content.english: 32:22 Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, * as we have hoped in thee.

segments.t: Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos: * quemádmodum sperávimus in te.

content.english: These were purchased from among men, the firstfruits to God and to the Lamb: And in their mouth there was found no lie; for they are without spot before the throne of God.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Deus, cuius hodiérna die præcónium Innocéntes Mártyres non loquéndo, sed moriéndo conféssi sunt: ómnia in nobis vitiórum mala mortífica; ut fidem tuam, quam lingua nostra lóquitur, étiam móribus vita fateátur.
content.english: O God, whose praise the martyred Innocents on this day confessed, not by speaking, but by dying, destroy all the evils of sin in us, that our life also may proclaim in deeds, thy faith which our tongues profess.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.english: ℟. Amen.

content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

content.latin: Psalmus 109 [1]
content.english: Psalm 109 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 109

content.latin: 109:1 Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: * Sede a dextris meis:
content.english: 109:1 The Lord said to my Lord: * Sit thou at my right hand:

segments.t: Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: * Sede a dextris meis:

content.latin: 109:1 Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.
content.english: 109:1 Until I make thy enemies * thy footstool.

segments.t: Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.

content.latin: 109:2 Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: * domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.
content.english: 109:2 The Lord will send forth the sceptre of thy power out of Sion: * rule thou in the midst of thy enemies.

segments.t: Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: * domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.

content.latin: 109:3 Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: * ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.
content.english: 109:3 With thee is the principality in the day of thy strength: in the brightness of the saints: * from the womb before the day star I begot thee.

segments.t: Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: * ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.

content.latin: 109:4 Iurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: * Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
content.english: 109:4 The Lord hath sworn, and he will not repent: * Thou art a priest for ever according to the order of Melchisedech.

segments.t: Iurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: * Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.

content.latin: 109:5 Dóminus a dextris tuis, * confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.
content.english: 109:5 The Lord at thy right hand * hath broken kings in the day of his wrath.

segments.t: Dóminus a dextris tuis, * confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.

content.latin: 109:6 Iudicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: * conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.
content.english: 109:6 He shall judge among nations, he shall fill ruins: * he shall crush the heads in the land of many.

segments.t: Iudicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: * conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.

content.latin: 109:7 De torrénte in via bibet: * proptérea exaltábit caput.
content.english: 109:7 He shall drink of the torrent in the way: * therefore shall he lift up the head.

segments.t: De torrénte in via bibet: * proptérea exaltábit caput.

content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.english: Ant. The Lord sent redemption * unto His people, He hath commanded His covenant for ever.

segments.t: Ant.
Redemptiónem * misit Dóminus pópulo suo: mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.

content.latin: Psalmus 110 [2]
content.english: Psalm 110 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 110

content.latin: 110:1 Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * in consílio iustórum, et congregatióne.
content.english: 110:1 I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; * in the council of the just, and in the congregation.

segments.t: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * in consílio iustórum, et congregatióne.

content.latin: 110:2 Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.
content.english: 110:2 Great are the works of the Lord: * sought out according to all his wills.

segments.t: Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.

content.latin: 110:3 Conféssio et magnificéntia opus eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: 110:3 His work is praise and magnificence: * and his justice continueth for ever and ever.

segments.t: Conféssio et magnificéntia opus eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: 110:4 Memóriam fecit mirabílium suórum, miséricors et miserátor Dóminus: * escam dedit timéntibus se.
content.english: 110:4 He hath made a remembrance of his wonderful works, being a merciful and gracious Lord: * he hath given food to them that fear him.

segments.t: Memóriam fecit mirabílium suórum, miséricors et miserátor Dóminus: * escam dedit timéntibus se.

content.latin: 110:5 Memor erit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * virtútem óperum suórum annuntiábit pópulo suo:
content.english: 110:5 He will be mindful for ever of his covenant: * he will shew forth to his people the power of his works.

segments.t: Memor erit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * virtútem óperum suórum annuntiábit pópulo suo:

content.latin: 110:7 Ut det illis hereditátem géntium: * ópera mánuum eius véritas, et iudícium.
content.english: 110:7 That he may give them the inheritance of the Gentiles: * the works of his hands are truth and judgment.

segments.t: Ut det illis hereditátem géntium: * ópera mánuum eius véritas, et iudícium.

content.latin: 110:8 Fidélia ómnia mandáta eius: confirmáta in sǽculum sǽculi, * facta in veritáte et æquitáte.
content.english: 110:8 All his commandments are faithful: confirmed for ever and ever, * made in truth and equity.

segments.t: Fidélia ómnia mandáta eius: confirmáta in sǽculum sǽculi, * facta in veritáte et æquitáte.

content.latin: 110:9 Redemptiónem misit pópulo suo: * mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.
content.english: 110:9 He hath sent redemption to his people: * he hath commanded his covenant for ever.

segments.t: Redemptiónem misit pópulo suo: * mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.

content.latin: 110:9 (fit reverentia) Sanctum, et terríbile nomen eius: * inítium sapiéntiæ timor Dómini.
content.english: 110:9 (bow head) Holy and terrible is his name: * the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

segments.t: 110:9 (fit reverentia)
Sanctum, et terríbile nomen eius: * inítium sapiéntiæ timor Dómini.

content.latin: 110:10 Intelléctus bonus ómnibus faciéntibus eum: * laudátio eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: 110:10 A good understanding to all that do it: * his praise continueth for ever and ever.

segments.t: Psalmus 111

content.latin: 111:1 Beátus vir, qui timet Dóminum: * in mandátis eius volet nimis.
content.english: 111:1 Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord: * he shall delight exceedingly in his commandments.

segments.t: Beátus vir, qui timet Dóminum: * in mandátis eius volet nimis.

content.latin: 111:2 Potens in terra erit semen eius: * generátio rectórum benedicétur.
content.english: 111:2 His seed shall be mighty upon earth: * the generation of the righteous shall be blessed.

segments.t: Potens in terra erit semen eius: * generátio rectórum benedicétur.

content.latin: 111:3 Glória, et divítiæ in domo eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: 111:3 Glory and wealth shall be in his house: * and his justice remaineth for ever and ever.

segments.t: Glória, et divítiæ in domo eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: 111:4 Exórtum est in ténebris lumen rectis: * miséricors, et miserátor, et iustus.
content.english: 111:4 To the righteous a light is risen up in darkness: * he is merciful, and compassionate and just.

segments.t: Exórtum est in ténebris lumen rectis: * miséricors, et miserátor, et iustus.

content.latin: 111:5 Iucúndus homo qui miserétur et cómmodat, dispónet sermónes suos in iudício: * quia in ætérnum non commovébitur.
content.english: 111:5 Acceptable is the man that sheweth mercy and lendeth: he shall order his words with judgment: * because he shall not be moved for ever.

segments.t: Iucúndus homo qui miserétur et cómmodat, dispónet sermónes suos in iudício: * quia in ætérnum non commovébitur.

content.latin: 111:7 In memória ætérna erit iustus: * ab auditióne mala non timébit.
content.english: 111:7 The just shall be in everlasting remembrance: * he shall not fear the evil hearing.

segments.t: In memória ætérna erit iustus: * ab auditióne mala non timébit.

content.latin: 111:7 Parátum cor eius speráre in Dómino, confirmátum est cor eius: * non commovébitur donec despíciat inimícos suos.
content.english: 111:7 His heart is ready to hope in the Lord: his heart is strengthened, * he shall not be moved until he look over his enemies.

segments.t: Parátum cor eius speráre in Dómino, confirmátum est cor eius: * non commovébitur donec despíciat inimícos suos.

content.latin: 111:9 Dispérsit, dedit paupéribus: iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi, * cornu eius exaltábitur in glória.
content.english: 111:9 He hath distributed, he hath given to the poor: his justice remaineth for ever and ever: * his horn shall be exalted in glory.

segments.t: Dispérsit, dedit paupéribus: iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi, * cornu eius exaltábitur in glória.

content.latin: 111:10 Peccátor vidébit, et irascétur, déntibus suis fremet et tabéscet: * desidérium peccatórum períbit.
content.english: 111:10 The wicked shall see, and shall be angry, he shall gnash with his teeth and pine away: * the desire of the wicked shall perish.

segments.t: Peccátor vidébit, et irascétur, déntibus suis fremet et tabéscet: * desidérium peccatórum períbit.

content.english: Psalm 129 [4]

content.latin: 129:1 De profúndis clamávi ad te, Dómine: * Dómine, exáudi vocem meam:
content.english: 129:1 Out of the depths I have cried to thee, O Lord: * Lord, hear my voice.

segments.t: De profúndis clamávi ad te, Dómine: * Dómine, exáudi vocem meam:

content.latin: 129:2 Fiant aures tuæ intendéntes, * in vocem deprecatiónis meæ.
content.english: 129:2 Let thy ears be attentive * to the voice of my supplication.

segments.t: Fiant aures tuæ intendéntes, * in vocem deprecatiónis meæ.

content.latin: 129:3 Si iniquitátes observáveris, Dómine: * Dómine, quis sustinébit?
content.english: 129:3 If thou, O Lord, wilt mark iniquities: * Lord, who shall stand it.

segments.t: Si iniquitátes observáveris, Dómine: * Dómine, quis sustinébit?

content.latin: 129:4 Quia apud te propitiátio est: * et propter legem tuam sustínui te, Dómine.
content.english: 129:4 For with thee there is merciful forgiveness: * and by reason of thy law, I have waited for thee, O Lord.

segments.t: Quia apud te propitiátio est: * et propter legem tuam sustínui te, Dómine.

content.latin: 129:5 Sustínuit ánima mea in verbo eius: * sperávit ánima mea in Dómino.
content.english: 129:5 My soul hath relied on his word: * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

segments.t: Sustínuit ánima mea in verbo eius: * sperávit ánima mea in Dómino.

content.latin: 129:6 A custódia matutína usque ad noctem: * speret Israël in Dómino.
content.english: 129:6 From the morning watch even until night, * let Israel hope in the Lord.

segments.t: A custódia matutína usque ad noctem: * speret Israël in Dómino.

content.latin: 129:7 Quia apud Dóminum misericórdia: * et copiósa apud eum redémptio.
content.english: 129:7 Because with the Lord there is mercy: * and with him plentiful redemption.

segments.t: Quia apud Dóminum misericórdia: * et copiósa apud eum redémptio.

content.latin: 129:8 Et ipse rédimet Israël, * ex ómnibus iniquitátibus eius.
content.english: 129:8 And he shall redeem Israel * from all his iniquities.

segments.t: Et ipse rédimet Israël, * ex ómnibus iniquitátibus eius.

content.latin: Psalmus 131 [5]
content.english: Psalm 131 [5]

segments.t: Psalmus 131

content.latin: 131:1 Meménto, Dómine, David, * et omnis mansuetúdinis eius:
content.english: 131:1 Lord, remember David, * and all his meekness.

segments.t: Meménto, Dómine, David, * et omnis mansuetúdinis eius:

content.latin: 131:2 Sicut iurávit Dómino, * votum vovit Deo Iacob:
content.english: 131:2 How he swore to the Lord, * he vowed a vow to the God of Jacob:

segments.t: Sicut iurávit Dómino, * votum vovit Deo Iacob:

content.latin: 131:3 Si introíero in tabernáculum domus meæ, * si ascéndero in lectum strati mei:
content.english: 131:3 If I shall enter into the tabernacle of my house: * if I shall go up into the bed wherein I lie:

segments.t: Si introíero in tabernáculum domus meæ, * si ascéndero in lectum strati mei:

content.latin: 131:4 Si dédero somnum óculis meis, * et pálpebris meis dormitatiónem:
content.english: 131:4 If I shall give sleep to my eyes, * or slumber to my eyelids,

segments.t: Si dédero somnum óculis meis, * et pálpebris meis dormitatiónem:

content.latin: 131:5 Et réquiem tempóribus meis: donec invéniam locum Dómino, * tabernáculum Deo Iacob.
content.english: 131:5 Or rest to my temples: until I find out a place for the Lord, * a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

segments.t: Et réquiem tempóribus meis: donec invéniam locum Dómino, * tabernáculum Deo Iacob.

content.latin: 131:6 Ecce, audívimus eam in Éphrata: * invénimus eam in campis silvæ.
content.english: 131:6 Behold we have heard of it in Ephrata: * we have found it in the fields of the wood.

segments.t: Ecce, audívimus eam in Éphrata: * invénimus eam in campis silvæ.

content.latin: 131:7 Introíbimus in tabernáculum eius: * adorábimus in loco, ubi stetérunt pedes eius.
content.english: 131:7 We will go into his tabernacle: * we will adore in the place where his feet stood.

segments.t: Introíbimus in tabernáculum eius: * adorábimus in loco, ubi stetérunt pedes eius.

content.latin: 131:8 Surge, Dómine, in réquiem tuam, * tu et arca sanctificatiónis tuæ.
content.english: 131:8 Arise, O Lord, into thy resting place: * thou and the ark, which thou hast sanctified.

segments.t: Surge, Dómine, in réquiem tuam, * tu et arca sanctificatiónis tuæ.

content.latin: 131:9 Sacerdótes tui induántur iustítiam: * et sancti tui exsúltent.
content.english: 131:9 Let thy priests be clothed with justice: * and let thy saints rejoice.

segments.t: Sacerdótes tui induántur iustítiam: * et sancti tui exsúltent.

content.latin: 131:10 Propter David, servum tuum, * non avértas fáciem Christi tui.
content.english: 131:10 For thy servant David’s sake, * turn not away the face of thy anointed.

segments.t: Propter David, servum tuum, * non avértas fáciem Christi tui.

content.latin: 131:11 Iurávit Dóminus David veritátem, et non frustrábitur eam: * De fructu ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.
content.english: 131:11 The Lord hath sworn truth to David, and he will not make it void: * of the fruit of thy womb I will set upon thy throne.

segments.t: Iurávit Dóminus David veritátem, et non frustrábitur eam: * De fructu ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.

content.latin: 131:12 Si custodíerint fílii tui testaméntum meum, * et testimónia mea hæc, quæ docébo eos:
content.english: 131:12 If thy children will keep my covenant, * and these my testimonies which I shall teach them:

segments.t: Si custodíerint fílii tui testaméntum meum, * et testimónia mea hæc, quæ docébo eos:

content.latin: 131:12 Et fílii eórum usque in sǽculum, * sedébunt super sedem tuam.
content.english: 131:12 Their children also for evermore * shall sit upon thy throne.

segments.t: Et fílii eórum usque in sǽculum, * sedébunt super sedem tuam.

content.latin: 131:13 Quóniam elégit Dóminus Sion: * elégit eam in habitatiónem sibi.
content.english: 131:13 For the Lord hath chosen Sion: * he hath chosen it for his dwelling.

segments.t: Quóniam elégit Dóminus Sion: * elégit eam in habitatiónem sibi.

content.latin: 131:14 Hæc réquies mea in sǽculum sǽculi: * hic habitábo quóniam elégi eam.
content.english: 131:14 This is my rest for ever and ever: * here will I dwell, for I have chosen it.

segments.t: Hæc réquies mea in sǽculum sǽculi: * hic habitábo quóniam elégi eam.

content.latin: 131:15 Víduam eius benedícens benedícam: * páuperes eius saturábo pánibus.
content.english: 131:15 Blessing I will bless her widow: * I will satisfy her poor with bread.

segments.t: Víduam eius benedícens benedícam: * páuperes eius saturábo pánibus.

content.latin: 131:16 Sacerdótes eius índuam salutári: * et sancti eius exsultatióne exsultábunt.
content.english: 131:16 I will clothe her priests with salvation: * and her saints shall rejoice with exceeding great joy.

segments.t: Sacerdótes eius índuam salutári: * et sancti eius exsultatióne exsultábunt.

content.latin: 131:17 Illuc prodúcam cornu David, * parávi lucérnam Christo meo.
content.english: 131:17 There will I bring forth a horn to David: * I have prepared a lamp for my anointed.

segments.t: Illuc prodúcam cornu David, * parávi lucérnam Christo meo.

content.latin: 131:18 Inimícos eius índuam confusióne: * super ipsum autem efflorébit sanctificátio mea.
content.english: 131:18 His enemies I will clothe with confusion: * but upon him shall my sanctification flourish.

segments.t: Inimícos eius índuam confusióne: * super ipsum autem efflorébit sanctificátio mea.

content.english: 1:46 My soul ✠ * doth magnify the Lord.

segments.t: Magníficat ✠ * ánima mea Dóminum.

content.latin: 1:47 Et exsultávit spíritus meus: * in Deo, salutári meo.
content.english: 1:47 And my spirit hath rejoiced * in God my Saviour.

segments.t: Et exsultávit spíritus meus: * in Deo, salutári meo.

content.latin: 1:48 Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.
content.english: 1:48 Because he hath regarded the humility of his handmaid; * for behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

segments.t: Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.

content.latin: 1:49 Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen eius.
content.english: 1:49 Because he that is mighty, hath done great things to me; * and holy is his name.

segments.t: Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen eius.

content.latin: 1:50 Et misericórdia eius, a progénie in progénies: * timéntibus eum.
content.english: 1:50 And his mercy is from generation unto generations, * to them that fear him.

segments.t: Et misericórdia eius, a progénie in progénies: * timéntibus eum.

content.latin: 1:51 Fecit poténtiam in brácchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.
content.english: 1:51 He hath shewed might in his arm: * he hath scattered the proud in the conceit of their heart.

segments.t: Fecit poténtiam in brácchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.

content.latin: 1:52 Depósuit poténtes de sede: * et exaltávit húmiles.

segments.t: Depósuit poténtes de sede: * et exaltávit húmiles.

content.latin: 1:53 Esuriéntes implévit bonis: * et dívites dimísit inánes.

segments.t: Esuriéntes implévit bonis: * et dívites dimísit inánes.

content.latin: 1:54 Suscépit Israël púerum suum: * recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.

segments.t: Suscépit Israël púerum suum: * recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.

content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Deus, cuius hodiérna die præcónium Innocéntes Mártyres non loquéndo, sed moriéndo conféssi sunt: ómnia in nobis vitiórum mala mortífica; ut fidem tuam, quam lingua nostra lóquitur, étiam móribus vita fateátur.
content.english: O God, whose praise the martyred Innocents on this day confessed, not by speaking, but by dying, destroy all the evils of sin in us, that our life also may proclaim in deeds, thy faith which our tongues profess.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: Commemoratio Diei IV infra Octavam Nativitatis
content.english: Commemoration of Fourth day after Christmas

segments.t: Commemoratio Diei IV infra Octavam Nativitatis

content.latin: Ant. Hódie Christus natus est: hódie Salvátor appáruit: hódie in terra canunt Angeli, lætántur Archángeli: hódie exsúltant iusti, dicéntes: Glória in excélsis Deo, allelúia.
content.english: Ant. This day the Christ is born this day the Saviour is appeared; this day the Angels sing praise in the earth and the Archangels rejoice; this day the righteous are glad and say: Glory to God in the highest. Alleluia.

segments.t: Ant.
Hódie Christus natus est: hódie Salvátor appáruit: hódie in terra canunt Angeli, lætántur Archángeli: hódie exsúltant iusti, dicéntes: Glória in excélsis Deo, allelúia.

content.latin: ℣. Notum fecit Dóminus, allelúia.
content.english: ℣. The Lord hath made known, alleluia.

segments.t: Notum fecit Dóminus, allelúia.

content.latin: ℟. Salutáre suum, allelúia.
content.english: ℟. His salvation, alleluia.

segments.t: Salutáre suum, allelúia.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Concéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut nos Unigéniti tui nova per carnem Natívitas líberet; quos sub peccáti iugo vetústa sérvitus tenet.
content.english: Grant, we beseech thee, almighty God, that the new birth of thy Only-begotten Son as man may set us free, who are held by the old bondage under the yoke of sin.

content.latin: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Noctem quiétam et finem perféctum concédat nobis Dóminus omnípotens.
content.english: Benediction. May almighty God grant us a quiet night and a perfect end.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Noctem quiétam et finem perféctum concédat nobis Dóminus omnípotens.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: Fratres: Sóbrii estóte, et vigiláte: quia adversárius vester diábolus tamquam leo rúgiens círcuit, quærens quem dévoret: cui resístite fortes in fide.
content.english: Brothers: Be sober and watch: because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, goeth about seeking whom he may devour. Whom resist ye, strong in faith.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Adiutórium nostrum ✠ in nómine Dómini.
content.english: ℣. Our help is ✠ in the name of the Lord,

segments.t: Adiutórium nostrum ✠ in nómine Dómini.

content.latin: ℟. Qui fecit cælum et terram.
content.english: ℟. Who made heaven and earth.

segments.t: Qui fecit cælum et terram.

content.latin: Examen conscientiæ vel Pater Noster totum secreto.
content.english: There follows an examination of conscience, or the Our Father said silently.

segments.t: Examen conscientiæ vel Pater Noster totum secreto.

content.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris: et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem: sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
content.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation: But deliver us from evil. Amen.

content.latin: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere: percutit sibi pectus mea culpa, mea culpa, mea máxima culpa. Ídeo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Ioánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, et omnes Sanctos, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.
content.english: I confess to almighty God, to blessed Mary ever Virgin, to blessed Michael the Archangel, to blessed John the Baptist, to the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and to all the Saints, that I have sinned exceedingly in thought, word and deed: strikes his breast through my fault, through my fault, through my most grievous fault. Therefore I beseech blessed Mary ever Virgin, blessed Michael the Archangel, blessed John the Baptist, the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and all the Saints, to pray for me to the Lord our God.

segments.t: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere:
percutit sibi pectus

mea culpa, mea culpa, mea máxima culpa. Ídeo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Ioánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, et omnes Sanctos, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.

content.latin: Misereátur nostri omnípotens Deus, et dimíssis peccátis nostris, perdúcat nos ad vitam ætérnam. Amen.
content.english: May almighty God have mercy on us, forgive us our sins, and bring us to everlasting life. Amen.

content.latin: Indulgéntiam, ✠ absolutiónem et remissiónem peccatórum nostrórum tríbuat nobis omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus. Amen.
content.english: May the almighty ✠ and merciful Lord grant us pardon, absolution and remission of our sins. Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Convérte nos ✙︎ Deus, salutáris noster.
content.english: ℣. Turn us then, ✙︎ O God, our saviour:

segments.t: Convérte nos ✙︎ Deus, salutáris noster.

content.latin: ℟. Et avérte iram tuam a nobis.
content.english: ℟. And let thy anger cease from us.

segments.t: Et avérte iram tuam a nobis.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Ant. Miserére * mihi, Dómine, et exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: Ant. Have mercy * on me, O Lord, and hear my prayer.

segments.t: Ant.
Miserére * mihi, Dómine, et exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: Psalmus 4 [1]
content.english: Psalm 4 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 4

content.latin: 4:2 Cum invocárem exaudívit me Deus iustítiæ meæ: * in tribulatióne dilatásti mihi.
content.english: 4:2 When I called upon him, the God of my justice heard me: * when I was in distress, thou hast enlarged me.

segments.t: Cum invocárem exaudívit me Deus iustítiæ meæ: * in tribulatióne dilatásti mihi.

content.latin: 4:2 Miserére mei, * et exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: 4:2 Have mercy on me: * and hear my prayer.

segments.t: Miserére mei, * et exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: 4:3 Fílii hóminum, úsquequo gravi corde? * ut quid dilígitis vanitátem, et quǽritis mendácium?
content.english: 4:3 O ye sons of men, how long will you be dull of heart? * Why do you love vanity, and seek after lying?

segments.t: Fílii hóminum, úsquequo gravi corde? * ut quid dilígitis vanitátem, et quǽritis mendácium?

content.latin: 4:4 Et scitóte quóniam mirificávit Dóminus sanctum suum: * Dóminus exáudiet me cum clamávero ad eum.
content.english: 4:4 Know ye also that the Lord hath made his holy one wonderful: * the Lord will hear me when I shall cry unto him.

segments.t: Et scitóte quóniam mirificávit Dóminus sanctum suum: * Dóminus exáudiet me cum clamávero ad eum.

content.latin: 4:5 Irascímini, et nolíte peccáre: * quæ dícitis in córdibus vestris, in cubílibus vestris compungímini.
content.english: 4:5 Be ye angry, and sin not: * the things you say in your hearts, be sorry for them upon your beds.

segments.t: Irascímini, et nolíte peccáre: * quæ dícitis in córdibus vestris, in cubílibus vestris compungímini.

content.latin: 4:6 Sacrificáte sacrifícium iustítiæ, et speráte in Dómino. * Multi dicunt: Quis osténdit nobis bona?
content.english: 4:6 Offer up the sacrifice of justice, and trust in the Lord: * many say, Who sheweth us good things?

segments.t: Sacrificáte sacrifícium iustítiæ, et speráte in Dómino. * Multi dicunt: Quis osténdit nobis bona?

content.latin: 4:7 Signátum est super nos lumen vultus tui, Dómine: * dedísti lætítiam in corde meo.
content.english: 4:7 The light of thy countenance, O Lord, is signed upon us: * thou hast given gladness in my heart.

segments.t: Signátum est super nos lumen vultus tui, Dómine: * dedísti lætítiam in corde meo.

content.latin: 4:8 A fructu fruménti, vini, et ólei sui * multiplicáti sunt.
content.english: 4:8 By the fruit of their corn, their wine, and oil, * they are multiplied.

segments.t: A fructu fruménti, vini, et ólei sui * multiplicáti sunt.

content.latin: 4:9 In pace in idípsum * dórmiam, et requiéscam;
content.english: 4:9 In peace in the selfsame * I will sleep, and I will rest:

segments.t: In pace in idípsum * dórmiam, et requiéscam;

content.latin: 4:10 Quóniam tu, Dómine, singuláriter in spe * constituísti me.
content.english: 4:10 For thou, O Lord, singularly * hast settled me in hope.

segments.t: Quóniam tu, Dómine, singuláriter in spe * constituísti me.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Psalmus 90 [2]
content.english: Psalm 90 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 90

content.latin: 90:1 Qui hábitat in adiutório Altíssimi, * in protectióne Dei cæli commorábitur.
content.english: 90:1 He that dwelleth in the aid of the most High, * shall abide under the protection of the God of Jacob.

segments.t: Qui hábitat in adiutório Altíssimi, * in protectióne Dei cæli commorábitur.

content.latin: 90:2 Dicet Dómino: Suscéptor meus es tu, et refúgium meum: * Deus meus sperábo in eum.
content.english: 90:2 He shall say to the Lord: Thou art my protector, and my refuge: * my God, in him will I trust.

segments.t: Dicet Dómino: Suscéptor meus es tu, et refúgium meum: * Deus meus sperábo in eum.

content.latin: 90:3 Quóniam ipse liberávit me de láqueo venántium, * et a verbo áspero.
content.english: 90:3 For he hath delivered me from the snare of the hunters: * and from the sharp word.

segments.t: Quóniam ipse liberávit me de láqueo venántium, * et a verbo áspero.

content.latin: 90:4 Scápulis suis obumbrábit tibi: * et sub pennis eius sperábis.
content.english: 90:4 He will overshadow thee with his shoulders: * and under his wings thou shalt trust.

segments.t: Scápulis suis obumbrábit tibi: * et sub pennis eius sperábis.

content.latin: 90:5 Scuto circúmdabit te véritas eius: * non timébis a timóre noctúrno,
content.english: 90:5 His truth shall compass thee with a shield: * thou shalt not be afraid of the terror of the night.

segments.t: Scuto circúmdabit te véritas eius: * non timébis a timóre noctúrno,

content.latin: 90:6 A sagítta volánte in die, a negótio perambulánte in ténebris: * ab incúrsu, et dæmónio meridiáno.
content.english: 90:6 Of the arrow that flieth in the day, of the business that walketh about in the dark: * of invasion, or of the noonday devil.

segments.t: A sagítta volánte in die, a negótio perambulánte in ténebris: * ab incúrsu, et dæmónio meridiáno.

content.latin: 90:7 Cadent a látere tuo mille, et decem míllia a dextris tuis: * ad te autem non appropinquábit.
content.english: 90:7 A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand: * but it shall not come nigh thee.

segments.t: Cadent a látere tuo mille, et decem míllia a dextris tuis: * ad te autem non appropinquábit.

content.latin: 90:8 Verúmtamen óculis tuis considerábis: * et retributiónem peccatórum vidébis.
content.english: 90:8 But thou shalt consider with thy eyes: * and shalt see the reward of the wicked.

segments.t: Verúmtamen óculis tuis considerábis: * et retributiónem peccatórum vidébis.

content.latin: 90:9 Quóniam tu es, Dómine, spes mea: * Altíssimum posuísti refúgium tuum.
content.english: 90:9 Because thou, O Lord, art my hope: * thou hast made the most High thy refuge.

segments.t: Quóniam tu es, Dómine, spes mea: * Altíssimum posuísti refúgium tuum.

content.latin: 90:10 Non accédet ad te malum: * et flagéllum non appropinquábit tabernáculo tuo.
content.english: 90:10 There shall no evil come to thee: * nor shall the scourge come near thy dwelling.

segments.t: Non accédet ad te malum: * et flagéllum non appropinquábit tabernáculo tuo.

content.latin: 90:11 Quóniam Ángelis suis mandávit de te: * ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
content.english: 90:11 For he hath given his angels charge over thee; * to keep thee in all thy ways.

segments.t: Quóniam Ángelis suis mandávit de te: * ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.

content.latin: 90:12 In mánibus portábunt te: * ne forte offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.
content.english: 90:12 In their hands they shall bear thee up: * lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

segments.t: In mánibus portábunt te: * ne forte offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.

content.latin: 90:13 Super áspidem, et basilíscum ambulábis: * et conculcábis leónem et dracónem.
content.english: 90:13 Thou shalt walk upon the asp and the basilisk: * and thou shalt trample under foot the lion and the dragon.

segments.t: Super áspidem, et basilíscum ambulábis: * et conculcábis leónem et dracónem.

content.latin: 90:14 Quóniam in me sperávit, liberábo eum: * prótegam eum, quóniam cognóvit nomen meum.
content.english: 90:14 Because he hoped in me I will deliver him: * I will protect him because he hath known my name.

segments.t: Quóniam in me sperávit, liberábo eum: * prótegam eum, quóniam cognóvit nomen meum.

content.latin: 90:15 Clamábit ad me, et ego exáudiam eum: * cum ipso sum in tribulatióne: erípiam eum et glorificábo eum.
content.english: 90:15 He shall cry to me, and I will hear him: * I am with him in tribulation, I will deliver him, and I will glorify him.

segments.t: Clamábit ad me, et ego exáudiam eum: * cum ipso sum in tribulatióne: erípiam eum et glorificábo eum.

content.latin: 90:16 Longitúdine diérum replébo eum: * et osténdam illi salutáre meum.
content.english: 90:16 I will fill him with length of days; * and I will shew him my salvation.

segments.t: Longitúdine diérum replébo eum: * et osténdam illi salutáre meum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Psalmus 133 [3]
content.english: Psalm 133 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 133

content.latin: 133:1 Ecce nunc benedícite Dóminum, * omnes servi Dómini:
content.english: 133:1 Behold now bless ye the Lord, * all ye servants of the Lord:

segments.t: Ecce nunc benedícite Dóminum, * omnes servi Dómini:

content.latin: 133:1 Qui statis in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri.
content.english: 133:1 Who stand in the house of the Lord, * in the courts of the house of our God.

segments.t: Qui statis in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri.

content.latin: 133:2 In nóctibus extóllite manus vestras in sancta, * et benedícite Dóminum.
content.english: 133:2 In the nights lift up your hands to the holy places, * and bless ye the Lord.

segments.t: In nóctibus extóllite manus vestras in sancta, * et benedícite Dóminum.

content.latin: 133:3 Benedícat te Dóminus ex Sion, * qui fecit cælum et terram.
content.english: 133:3 May the Lord out of Sion bless thee, * he that made heaven and earth.

segments.t: Benedícat te Dóminus ex Sion, * qui fecit cælum et terram.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.english: Ant. Have mercy on me, O Lord, and hear my prayer.

Miserére mihi, Dómine, et exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: Te lucis ante términum,
content.english: Before the ending of the day,

content.latin: Rerum Creátor, póscimus,
content.english: Creator of the world, we pray

content.latin: Ut pro tua cleméntia
content.english: That with thy wonted favor thou

content.latin: Sis præsul et custódia.
content.english: Wouldst be our guard and keeper now.

content.latin: Procul recédant sómnia,
content.english: From all ill dreams defend our eyes,

content.latin: Et nóctium phantásmata;
content.english: From nightly fears and fantasies;

content.latin: Hostémque nostrum cómprime,
content.english: Tread under foot our ghostly foe,

content.latin: Ne polluántur córpora.
content.english: That no pollution we may know.

content.latin: Præsta, Pater piíssime,
content.english: O Father, that we ask be done,

content.latin: Patríque compar Únice,
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thine only Son;

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito
content.english: Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,

content.latin: Regnans per omne sǽculum.
content.english: Doth live and reign eternally.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Ier 14:9
content.english: Jer 14:9

segments.t: Ier 14:9

content.latin: Tu autem in nobis es, Dómine, et nomen sanctum tuum invocátum est super nos: ne derelínquas nos, Dómine, Deus noster.
content.english: But thou, O Lord, art among us, and thy name is called upon by us: forsake us not, O Lord our God.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.

content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Vísita, quǽsumus, Dómine, habitatiónem istam, et omnes insídias inimíci ab ea longe repélle: Ángeli tui sancti hábitent in ea, qui nos in pace custódiant; et benedíctio tua sit super nos semper.
content.english: Visit, we beseech thee, O Lord, this dwelling, and drive far from it the snares of the enemy; let thy holy angels dwell herein to preserve us in peace, and let thy blessing be always upon us.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

content.english: Mother of Christ, hear thou thy people's cry

content.english: Star of the deep and Portal of the sky!

content.latin: Súrgere qui curat, pópulo: tu quæ genuísti,
content.english: Mother of Him who thee from nothing made.

content.latin: Natúra miránte, tuum sanctum Genitórem,
content.english: Sinking we strive and call to thee for aid:

content.latin: Virgo prius ac postérius, Gabriélis ab ore
content.english: O, by what joy which Gabriel brought to thee,

content.latin: Sumens illud Ave, peccatórum miserére.
content.english: Thou Virgin first and last, let us thy mercy see.

content.latin: ℣. Post partum, Virgo, invioláta permansísti.
content.english: ℣. After childbirth thou didst remain a virgin.

segments.t: Post partum, Virgo, invioláta permansísti.

content.latin: ℟. Dei Génetrix, intercéde pro nobis.
content.english: ℟. Intercede for us, O Mother of God.

segments.t: Dei Génetrix, intercéde pro nobis.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Deus, qui salútis ætérnæ, beátæ Maríæ virginitáte fecúnda, humáno géneri prǽmia præstitísti: tríbue, quǽsumus; ut ipsam pro nobis intercédere sentiámus, per quam merúimus auctórem vitæ suscípere, Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum. Amen.
content.english: O God, who, by the fruitful virginity of blessed Mary, hast bestowed upon mankind the reward of eternal salvation: grant, we beseech thee, that we may experience her intercession, through whom we have been made worthy to receive the author of life, Our Lord Jesus Christ thy Son. Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Divínum auxílium ✠ máneat semper nobíscum.
content.english: ℣. May the divine assistance ✠ remain with us always.

segments.t: Divínum auxílium ✠ máneat semper nobíscum.
